capability: Replace a non-atomic read-modify-write with an atomic fetch-and-add.
observed_failure:
thread 'tests::pair_bumps_twice' panicked at tests/check.rs:6:5:
assertion `left == right` failed
  left: 1
 right: 2
prompt_intro:
`bump_pair` loses an update: both threads load the counter, meet at the
barrier, and store the same value plus one, so the counter ends at 1
instead of 2. `bump_all` has the same defect at scale. Use an atomic
read-modify-write so every call adds exactly one. Keep both signatures and
the barriers.
provenance: original; authored for SELVEDGE P12.9/P11.21 (S14), no public benchmark text
